section.content: The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, including battery case, lid, lithium ion battery board and controller, the controller includes microprocessor, current sampling module, electronic switch, electric quantity detection module, the lithium ion battery board is installed in battery case's mounting groove, the lid closes in the mounting groove, the lid surface is established first temperature sensor, the positive negative power port of lithium ion battery board is connected with the positive negative power port one-to-one on the lid, current sampling module series connection is between the positive power port of lithium ion battery board and the positive power port on the lid; the inner surface of the mounting groove is provided with a heat insulation material layer, the surface of the heat insulation material layer is provided with an electrothermal film, fluffy cotton is arranged in an interlayer between the lithium ion battery plate and the electrothermal film, and the surface of the lithium ion battery plate is also provided with a second temperature sensor; the circuit modules are connected in a matching way. When the temperature is lower than 0 ℃, the microprocessor controls the electronic switch to be switched on, and the electric heating film is electrified and heated, so that the lithium ion battery can be normally used.

本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池，包括电池外壳、盖体、锂离子电池板和控制器，控制器包括微处理器、电流采样模块、电子开关、电量检测模块，锂离子电池板安装在电池外壳的安装槽内，盖体盖合在安装槽，盖体表面设第一温度传感器，锂离子电池板的正负极电源端口与盖体上的正负极电源端口一一对应连接，电流采样模块串联连接于锂离子电池板的正极电源端口和盖体上的正极电源端口之间；安装槽内表面设有隔热材料层，隔热材料层表面设有电热膜，锂离子电池板与电热膜之间的夹层内设有蓬松棉，锂离子电池板表面还设有第二温度传感器；上述各电路模块间配合连接。当温度低于0℃时，微处理器控制电子开关导通，电热膜通电加热，使锂离子电池正常使用。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a power technical field especially relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

The lithium ion battery is a high-performance battery, has the advantages of high energy density, excellent self-discharge and small cycle performance, rapid charge and discharge, and high charging efficiency up to 100%, does not contain harmful substances, and is called as a green battery. The lithium battery has a wide application temperature range, can still be used outdoors in winter in the north, but has a large capacity reduction, and can recover the capacity if the temperature returns to the normal temperature. Research shows that when the environmental temperature is lower than 0 ℃, the capacity performance of the lithium ion battery is obviously reduced, which is not beneficial to the normal use of the lithium ion battery.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Therefore, to the above-mentioned problem, the utility model provides a can be less than the normal lithium ion battery who uses of 0 ℃ at ambient temperature.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme: a lithium ion battery comprises a battery shell, a cover body, a lithium ion battery plate and a controller, wherein the controller comprises a microprocessor, a current sampling module, an electronic switch and an electric quantity detection module, a mounting groove for mounting the lithium ion battery plate and the controller is formed in the battery shell, the cover body covers the opening position of the mounting groove, an anode power port and a cathode power port are formed in the cover body, the anode power port and the cathode power port of the lithium ion battery plate are connected with the anode power port and the cathode power port on the cover body in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the current sampling module is connected between the anode power port of the lithium ion battery plate and the anode power port on the cover body in series;

the inner surface of the mounting groove is provided with a heat insulation material layer, the surface of the heat insulation material layer is provided with an electrothermal film, an interlayer is formed between the lithium ion battery plate and the electrothermal film, fluffy cotton is arranged in the interlayer, and a temperature sensor is also arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery plate in the mounting groove; the power end and the electric quantity detection module of the microprocessor are respectively and electrically connected with the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate, the temperature sensor, the electronic switch and the electric quantity detection module are respectively and electrically connected with the I/O end of the microprocessor, and the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate are electrically connected with the electric heating film through the electronic switch to form a conductive loop.

Furthermore, a display screen is further arranged on the cover body and is in communication connection with the microprocessor.

Furthermore, the controller also comprises a voltage sampling module, the voltage sampling module is electrically connected with the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate, and the voltage sampling module is electrically connected with the I/O end of the microprocessor.

Furthermore, a loudspeaker is arranged on the cover body and is electrically connected with an I/O end of the microprocessor.

By adopting the technical scheme, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: this lithium ion battery is through setting up thermal insulation material layer in battery case's mounting groove, heat conduction is to battery case when reducing the electric heat membrane and generating heat, play thermal-insulated effect, and set up fluffy cotton in the intermediate layer between lithium ion battery board and the electric heat membrane, fluffy cotton plays heat retaining effect on the one hand, and on the other hand, lithium ion battery board is because expend with heat and contract with cold, fluffy structure of fluffy cotton can reserve certain space for lithium ion battery board expend with heat and contract with cold. When the first temperature sensor detects that the ambient temperature is lower than 0 ℃, the microprocessor controls the electronic switch to be switched on, the electric heating film is electrified to generate heat, along with the temperature rise, the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate is increased, and when the electric quantity detection module detects that the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate is not increased any more along with the temperature rise, the temperature at the moment is the maximum temperature of the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate, the microprocessor judges that the temperature is the optimal use temperature of the lithium ion battery plate, and the microprocessor controls the electric heating film to generate heat so that the temperature in the interlayer is maintained at the optimal use temperature. Furthermore, the display screen is used for displaying the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate detected by the electric quantity detection module, and when the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate is too low (lower than 10% of the rated battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate), the microprocessor controls the loudspeaker to give out an alarm sound; further, the voltage sampling module detects the voltage of the lithium ion battery panel and displays the voltage of the lithium ion battery panel on the display screen.

Drawings

fig. 2 is a cross-sectional view of an embodiment of the invention;

fig. 3 is a circuit connection block diagram of an embodiment of the present invention.

Detailed Description

The present invention will now be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings and detailed description.

Referring to fig. 1, 2 and 3, the present embodiment provides a lithium ion battery including a battery case 1, a cover 2, a lithium ion battery panel 3, a controller 4, a first temperature sensor 5, a second temperature sensor 6, a speaker 7 and a display screen 8. The cover body 2 is provided with a positive power port 21 and a negative power port 22, and the lithium ion battery plate 3 is correspondingly provided with a positive power port 31 and a negative power port 32. The controller 4 includes a microprocessor 41, a current sampling module 42, a voltage sampling module 43, an electronic switch 44, and an electric quantity detection module 45, in this embodiment, the preferred microprocessor 41 adopts an AT89C51 single chip microcomputer, the electronic switch 44 adopts a solid normally open relay, the current sampling module 42 is used for detecting the output current of the positive power port 31 of the lithium ion battery plate 3, the voltage sampling module 43 is used for detecting the voltage of the lithium ion battery plate 3, and the electric quantity detection module 45 is used for detecting the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate 3. All the electronic components and the circuit module are existing equipment.

The battery shell 1 is internally provided with an installation groove 10 for installing the lithium ion battery plate 3 and the controller 4, and the cover body 2 covers the opening position of the installation groove 10. 10 internal surfaces of mounting groove are provided with thermal insulation material layer 11, thermal insulation material layer 11 adopts the aerogel felt, thermal insulation material layer 11 surface is provided with electric heat membrane 12, forms the intermediate layer (not marking in the picture) between lithium ion battery board 3 and the electric heat membrane, be provided with fluffy cotton 13 in the intermediate layer, fluffy cotton 13 plays heat retaining effect on the one hand, and on the other hand, lithium ion battery board 3 is owing to expend with heat and contract with cold, and fluffy structure of fluffy cotton 13 can reserve certain space for expend with heat and contract with cold of lithium ion battery board 3. The second temperature sensor 6 is arranged in the mounting groove 10 and positioned on the surface of the lithium ion battery plate 3, and the second temperature sensor 6 is used for detecting the temperature in the interlayer.

Microprocessor 41's power end, voltage sampling module 43, electric quantity detection module 45 are connected with lithium ion battery board 3's positive power port 31 and negative pole power port 32 electricity respectively, first temperature sensor 5, second temperature sensor 6, speaker 7, electronic switch 44, electric quantity detection module 45 are connected with microprocessor 41's IO end electric connection respectively, electric heat membrane 12 is connected with electronic switch 44 electricity, lithium ion battery board 3's positive power port 31 and negative pole power port 32 are connected formation conductive loop through electronic switch 44 and electric heat membrane 12 electricity. The display screen 8 is in communication with the microprocessor 41.

When the first temperature sensor 5 detects that the ambient temperature is lower than 0 ℃, the microprocessor 41 controls the electronic switch 44 to be switched on, the electric heating film 12 is powered on to heat, along with the temperature rise, the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate 3 is increased, and along with the temperature rise, when the electric quantity detection module 45 detects that the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate 3 is not increased any more, the temperature at the moment is the maximum temperature of the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate 3, the microprocessor 41 judges that the temperature is the optimal use temperature of the lithium ion battery plate 3, and the microprocessor 41 controls the electric heating film 12 to heat so that the temperature in the interlayer is maintained at about 3 ℃ of the optimal use temperature. The display screen 8 displays the voltage and the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate 3 in real time, and the microprocessor 41 controls the loudspeaker 7 to give an alarm sound for several seconds to remind charging when the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery plate 3 is lower than 10% of the rated battery capacity.

While the invention has been particularly shown and described with reference to a preferred embodiment, it will be understood by those skilled in the art that various changes in form and detail may be made therein without departing from the spirit and scope of the invention as defined by the appended claims.
